dialogues.speaker: Kahinda
dialogues.text: #You're {NICKNAME}, right? We're not ashamed to lose to you, since we all know you fought alongside the Pyro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Mwindo
dialogues.text: Haha, don't be so surprised. Our neighbor's got a photo where he posed with you — he shows it off all the time. It's only natural we'd recognize the real deal.

dialogues.speaker: Kahinda
dialogues.text: Thank you, Tumaini. We're honored to be able to fight against you.
